question: The median of the observations 87, 56, 27, 31, 13, 39, 18, 80, 98, 92 and 25 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in **ascending order**: 13, 18, 25, 27, 31, 39, 56, 80, 87, 92, 98.

Total number of observations (n) = 11 (which is **Odd**).

Median = Middle term = ((11 + 1) / 2)th term = 6th term.

The 6th term in the sorted list is 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations = 87, 56, 27, 31, 13, 39, 18, 80, 98, 92, 25.

**Formula Used:** Median = ((n + 1) / 2)th term (when n is odd).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76efce3a1828ac0ebda6871175b88bc4a697ceebcb4a7eb1df161155aa02626c.png] 

⇒ Arrange observations in **ascending order**: 13, 18, 25, 27, 31, 39, 56, 80, 87, 92, 98.

⇒ Count of observations (n) = 11.

⇒ Median = ((11 + 1) / 2)th term.

⇒ Median = 6th term.

⇒ 6th term = 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Even n

If the number of observations (n) is even, the median is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Mean (Average)

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A set can have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode.</p
